data.bug_class: out-of-bounds array index (index -1) due to unsigned underflow of chain->len when the chain is empty (detected by UBSan array-bounds; effectively an out-of-bounds read on the dns_qpchain_t chain array)
data.rationale: add_link() unconditionally evaluates chain->chain[chain->len - 1].node to deduplicate links. When dns_qp_lookup() is entered, dns_qpchain_init() sets chain->len = 0. If the search key ends at the first leaf without any ancestor leaf having been recorded along the way (the add_link at qp.c:2080 is only reached for shorter parent names), the final add_link(chain, n, offset) at qp.c:2168 runs with len == 0, so chain->len - 1 computes 0u-1 and the expression indexes element -1 of the fixed 128-element chain[] array. Verified by building with the OSS-Fuzz UBSan configuration and running the dns_message_checksig fuzzer on the bundled 'sig0' seed: LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput (fuzz/dns_message_checksig.c:456) -> dns_message_checksig (message.c:3168, SIG(0) branch with view != NULL, first octet 0x81 sets addasig and withview) -> dns_view_simplefind (view.c:1061) -> dns_view_find (view.c:850) -> dns_zt_find (zt.c:181) -> dns_qp_lookup (qp.c:2168) -> add_link (qp.c:2000), reporting 'index -1 out of bounds for type struct ...[128]' and aborting (array-bounds is in -fno-sanitize-recover). The root cause is the missing empty-chain guard in add_link; the fix is to only inspect chain[len-1] when len > 0.
